dedupe_keys.name: final accounts financial statements of jordan s water companies for 2024 incl yarmouk water company ministry of water and irrigation

description: Jordan's Ministry of Water and Irrigation publishes the final accounts of the country's water companies on its website, one page per year. The 2024 page read on 2026-09-28 lists three files to view or download, among them the balance sheet of Yarmouk Water Company for the year ending 31 December 2024, each several megabytes. The other files were not identified by name in the part read, and none was opened, so the statements' contents, such as revenue, operating costs, debt or asset values, are not confirmed. Coverage is Jordan's water companies for the 2024 financial year; the page structure suggests a yearly series. Access is free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the documents are financial statements in Arabic, whether as searchable text or scanned images was not checked, and they describe finances, not physical networks. It supports water utility capacity and investment studies, such as relating a company's operating deficit to its non-revenue water or maintenance backlog when planning resilience investments. No related Jordanian water utility record is catalogued.
